login_page.layout: Split-screen or centered card with dark slate branding
elements: Role selection dropdown (Public, Corporate, Delivery Partner, Partner Hub, Admin)
Work Email / Username field with validation
Quick demo login presets buttons for instant testing
Material selector cards (Mixed Paper, Plastics, E-Waste, Metals)
Weight input toggle (Kg / Tons) with interactive slider & numeric input
Live Auto Earnings Calculator in INR (Weight * Material Rate)
Submit Request button with loading micro-animation

sub_sections: User Management (Filter by role, search, status switch)
Compliance & ESG Reports (Recycling impact metric, carbon offset)
Global Editable Material Price Rates Card (Paper, Plastic, E-Waste, Metal INR/kg rates)
CSV Export feature (export filtered pickup orders & user data)

plant_and_hub.alt: Sustainable waste recovery and recycling facility

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, forms, menu items, table rows, and metric indicators MUST have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the sidebar strictly uses dark slate `bg-slate-950` with an emerald logo mark `#10b981`.
Active sidebar navigation links MUST use the white pill style `bg-white text-slate-950 rounded-xl font-semibold shadow-sm`.
The main content area must use cool light grey `bg-[#f4f6f9]`.
Cards and data tables must use `bg-white border-slate-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm`.
Format all transaction IDs and weight values using bold monospace typography (`font-mono font-bold`).
Ensure all 5 user roles (Public, Corporate, Delivery Partner, Partner Hub, Admin) can log in seamlessly via quick role presets or credential login, with menus updated live for each role.
Provide live interactive state management for Sell Scrap form (auto-calculating INR earnings), Pickup status updates, Delivery driver order acceptance, Admin material rate updates, and CSV export.
